Human.desc: Adaptable and ambitious, humans gain power directly from their commander's growth.

thresholds.desc: Humans gain +30 Max Health and +3% Physical & Magic Attack per Player Level.
Humans gain +60 Max Health and +6% Physical & Magic Attack per Player Level.
[Needs 1 Crest] All allied units gain 50% of the Human level-scaling bonuses. Humans gain +10% Damage Amplification and 20% Max HP.

Ancient.desc: Mystical relic-keepers whose power grows when they fall, storing energy in a sacred chest.

thresholds.desc: Gain **+2 stacks** every time an allied unit dies (any unit, not just Ancients), and gain **$5 \times \text{current lose streak}$** when you lose a round.
Gain **+5 stacks** every time an allied unit dies, and gain **$7 \times \text{current lose streak}$** when you lose a round.
Gain **+7 stacks** every time an allied unit dies, and gain **$10 \times \text{current lose streak}$** when you lose a round.
Gain **+10 stacks** every time an allied unit dies, and gain **$15 \times \text{current lose streak}$** when you lose a round.

Noble.desc: Haughty royalty and wealthy merchant lords who buy victory.

thresholds.desc: Gain +1 Gold at end of even rounds.

Interest limit increases to 70 Gold (+1 gold for every 10g saved; 40g gives +5g interest, 70g maxes at 8g interest). Nobles gain +1% Damage Amplification for every 2 Gold in your bank (max 40%). Every 2 interest gold earned at round end permanently grants Nobles +5 HP.
[Needs 2 Crests] At round end, gain 25% of your total gold balance. Damage Amplification max increases to 100%. Permanent HP gain increases to +20 HP per 2 interest gold.

Dwarven Forge.desc: Master smiths and engineers who upgrade the team's weaponry.

thresholds.desc: Grants a consumable *Ornate Hammer*. Use it on a unit to choose one of their completed items and upgrade it to an **Ornate Masterwork Artifact**, gaining a powerful secondary passive.
Upgrades up to 3 completed items on your board to Ornate Masterwork Artifacts. All Dwarves gain +50% effectiveness from all items equipped on them.
[Needs 2 Crests] All equipped items on Dwarves are upgraded to Ornate Artifacts. Dwarves gain +20 DEF and MDEF per equipped item.

Demonic Pact.desc: Dark cultists who sacrifice their own vital essence to summon the Abyss.

thresholds.desc: When combat starts, the lowest-HP Demon is sacrificed, transferring their stats to other Demons as +20% Physical Attack and Magic Attack.
When 3 allied units die, summon a **Lesser Pit Lord** hex-construct with 1000 HP and 80 base damage onto the board.

[Needs 2 Crests] At the start of preparation phase, sacrifice **5 Player HP** (once) to permanently summon a **Great Demon Lord** (5-star Tier boss) into the combat team who inherits all active Demon synergy buffs.

Magic Tower.desc: Wizard orders channeling energy through conduits.

thresholds.desc: Every time an allied unit casts a skill, heal the nearest allies by 10% of the caster's Magic Attack (AP) stat.

Every time an allied unit casts their skill, it adds points equal to their gold cost to a global charge pool. When the pool reaches 50 points, summon a meteor dealing 10% current HP Magic Damage to all enemies.
[Needs 2 Crests] All skill casts add points equal to **10x** the unit's gold cost to the pool, triggering rapid meteor cascades.

Sylvan Elves.desc: Agile woodland archers and druids who blend into the brush.

thresholds.desc: Elves gain +15% Critical Chance and dodge 10% of basic attacks.
Elves gain +30% Critical Chance and dodge 20% of basic attacks. Every critical strike dealt heals the lowest HP ally for 25% of that damage.

[Needs 2 Crests] Elves gain +50% Critical Chance. Any Critical Chance exceeding 100% is converted into Critical Damage at a **1:5 ratio** (+1% CC = +5% Critical Damage). Healing on critical strike increases from 25% to 100% of damage dealt.

Necropolis Undead.desc: Legions of bone and decay that refuse to die.

thresholds.desc: The first allied unit to die is resurrected as a *Skeleton Soldier* with 50% HP and 50% Base Damage.
The first two allied units to die are resurrected, and Undead units gain +10% Lifesteal.

[Needs 2 Crests] All dead allied units are resurrected with 10% of their original health and 50% base damage. This cycle continues until every unit on the board is dead (summoned skeletons do not deal damage to player HP on victory).

Draconic Zealots.desc: Worshipers of ancient dragons who incubate massive dragon eggs.

thresholds.desc: Spawn a *Golden Dragon Egg* on your bench. It gains 1 hatch charge per round. Hatches after 4 rounds into a Drake Hatchling.
The egg hatches faster (2 charges per round). Draconic units gain +15% Physical Attack.
The hatched Dragon evolves into an Elder Wyvern, gaining fire-breath AoE skills.
[Needs 2 Crests] The Dragon ascends to a Legendary Cinder-Dragon, dealing 33% True Damage and gaining immune status to all crowd control.

Elemental Fairy.desc: Mystical spirits of nature that summon and merge with a massive golem.

thresholds.desc: Summon 1 **Elemental Golem** (Tank role) onto the board. All enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by 15%.
Any Fairy unit placed adjacent (within 1 hex) to the Elemental Golem during the preparation phase merges into the Golem. For every Fairy merged:

[Needs 1 Crest] Enemy Attack Speed slow increases to 33%. Tidal Wave triggers every 5 seconds and shreds Magic Defense (MDEF) by 33%. Golem base stats per merged Fairy increase from +20% to **+40%**, and all merged Fairy passive effects are **doubled** (e.g. Nature Fairy grants 2% HP regen).

Architect.desc: Master builders who direct fortifications and battle facilities.

thresholds.desc: Active Facilities have their Construction Phase delay reduced by **1 round**. Facilities gain +20 Max Health.
Grants **+1 extra Facility capacity** (maximum of 4). Active Facilities heal adjacent units for 3% of their max HP per second.
If a Facility is destroyed, the **Player HP damage penalty is completely negated**. Active Facilities gain +40 DEF and MDEF, and their offensive attack rates are doubled.

Mercenary.desc: Blades-for-hire who fight for gold and glory.

thresholds.desc: Scoring a round victory yields +1 "Bounty Box" (can open for 1-3 Gold or an item component).
Mercenary units deal +15% Damage Amplification. At the start of preparation phase, a temporary random high-tier unit is offered in the shop for free, which stays on your board for exactly 1 round.
Winning a round grants a completed item component. Each Mercenary unit gains +5% Lifesteal per item equipped on them.

Royal Guard.desc: Heavily armored knights sworn to protect the Crown.

thresholds.desc: At combat start, the highest-cost unit gains +200 HP and +20 DEF. When the King/Queen takes damage, Guards share 15% of that damage.
The King/Queen gains +500 HP, +40 DEF, and is immune to Crowd Control. Guards share 25% of all damage dealt to the King/Queen and gain +30 DEF.
If the King/Queen dies, Guards gain +100% Physical Attack and 33% Damage Reduction for the rest of combat.
Alchemists' attacks apply *Plague* for 5 seconds. Plague deals 1% max HP as True Damage per second and applies a 33% healing reduction.
Plague now spreads to adjacent enemies upon target death. Alchemists gain +15% Magic Attack.
Plagued units have their Physical and Magic Defenses shredded by 33%. Alchemists heal for 30% of all Plague damage dealt.
Every 6 seconds, increase all allies' Attack Speed by +15% (stacks up to 3 times).
At combat start, increase all allies' starting mana by +20, and delay enemy starting mana regeneration by 2 seconds.
Once per combat, when an ally falls below 20% HP, freeze time for all enemies in a 2-hex radius for 2.5 seconds (Stun state).

Gladiators.desc: Arena fighters who thrive on individual combat.

thresholds.desc: Gladiators deal +10% Damage Amplification. If a Gladiator has no adjacent allies at combat start, they gain a shield equal to 15% Max HP.
Gladiators execute target enemies who fall below 15% health, instantly dealing True Damage equal to their remaining HP.
Executes trigger at 25% health. Scoring an execution instantly restores 50 mana to the Gladiator.

Rogues.desc: Cloaked assassins who strike from the shadows.

thresholds.desc: At combat start, Rogues leap to the furthest hex in the enemy backline. Rogues gain +15% Critical Damage.
Rogues' critical strikes reduce the target's Physical Defense (DEF) by 33% for 5 seconds.
Scoring a critical strike grants the Rogue stealth for 1 second, resetting enemy targeting aggro.
Increase all incoming healing and shielding effects on your board by 20%.
Every 6 seconds, Clerics emit a holy burst, healing all allies within 2 hexes for 8% of their max HP.
Holy bursts also grant healed allies a temporary shield equal to 10% of their Max HP for 4 seconds.

Cavalry Knight.desc: Mounted warriors who charge into battle.

thresholds.desc: Cavalry units move 50% faster. At combat start, they charge their target, dealing Physical Damage equal to 10% of their Max HP and knocking them back 1 hex.
The charge stuns the target for 1.5 seconds and shreds their DEF by 33%.

Beast Tamer.desc: Forest guardians who fight alongside trained wild beasts.

thresholds.desc: Summon a *Tamed Wolf* companion with 500 HP and 40 Base Damage at combat start.
The Wolf gains +50% HP and basic attacks stun targets for 0.5 seconds.
Summon a second wolf. All beasts gain +33% Attack Speed.

Runesmith.desc: Enchanters carving defensive runes onto armor.

thresholds.desc: At combat start, frontline allies gain a shield equal to 15% of their Max HP.
While shielded, units reflect 33% of incoming basic attack damage back to attackers.

Card Gamblers.desc: Mages using card-magic to draw random combat shifts.

thresholds.desc: Draws one random card at round start:
Draws two cards. Effects apply to all allied units.

Doom Harbingers.desc: Dark executioners wielding scythes of death.

thresholds.desc: Harbingers deal +10% Damage Amplification. When they kill a unit, they gain +5% Physical Attack for the rest of combat.
Harbingers execute targets who fall below 15% HP. Scoring an execution heals the Harbinger for 33% of their missing HP.

Vanguard Berserkers.desc: Wild fighters who grow stronger as health drops.

thresholds.desc: Gain +1% Attack Speed for every 2% missing HP.
Gain +1% Attack Speed and +0.5% Physical Attack for every 1% missing HP.
[Needs 1 Crest] At 20% HP, Berserkers become immune to death for 3 seconds (occurs once per combat).

Rangers.desc: Elite archers specializing in rapid long-range firing.

thresholds.desc: Rangers gain +1 Hex attack range.
Every 3 seconds, Rangers gain +15% Attack Speed (stacks up to 5 times).
[Needs 1 Crest] Stacking Attack Speed increased to +25%. Rangers' critical hits deal +33% bonus True Damage.
